content:
此模組包包含與 [Skyblocker](https://modrinth.com/mod/skyblocker-liap) 模組一同使用的實用**輔助**與**效能**用戶端模組。\ \ 此模組包專為 hypixel.net 的 Skyblock 遊戲模式設計。 ![skyblocker modpack](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/a8a4c330bbdca709daf28afdf491b272afca6e74.png) ## 🔧 模組清單
已安裝模組（共 24 個模組） ### Hypixel 遊戲體驗優化模組： - [Skyblocker](https://modrinth.com/mod/skyblocker-liap) - [Aaron’s Mod](https://modrinth.com/mod/aaron-mod) ### 效能優化模組： - [Entity Culling](https://modrinth.com/mod/entityculling) - [FerriteCore](https://modrinth.com/mod/ferrite-core) - [ImmediatelyFast](https://modrinth.com/mod/immediatelyfast) - [Lithium](https://modrinth.com/mod/lithium) - [Sodium](https://modrinth.com/mod/sodium) ### 生活品質模組： - [Tooltip Scroll](https://modrinth.com/mod/tooltip-scroll) - [Chat Patches](https://modrinth.com/mod/chatpatches) - [Gamma Utils (全亮度)](https://modrinth.com/mod/gamma-utils) - [Reese's Sodium Options](https://modrinth.com/mod/reeses-sodium-options) - [Roughly Enough Items (REI)](https://modrinth.com/mod/rei) - [Sodium Extra](https://modrinth.com/mod/sodium-extra) ### 其他模組： - [Iris Shaders](https://modrinth.com/mod/iris) - [Mod Menu](https://modrinth.com/mod/modmenu) - [YOSBR](https://modrinth.com/mod/yosbr) - [Zoomify](https://modrinth.com/mod/zoomify) ### 函式庫： - [Architectury API](https://modrinth.com/mod/architectury-api) - [Cloth Config API](https://modrinth.com/mod/cloth-config) - [Fabric API](https://modrinth.com/mod/fabric-api) - [Fabric Language Kotlin](https://modrinth.com/mod/fabric-language-kotlin) - [YetAnotherConfigLib](https://modrinth.com/mod/yacl) - [Text Placeholder API](https://modrinth.com/mod/placeholder-api) - [Simple Modpack Update Checker](https://modrinth.com/mod/smuc)
## 🎨 推薦資源包
資源包 - [Hypixel Plus](https://modrinth.com/resourcepack/hypixel-plus) - 需要 [Catharsis](https://modrinth.com/mod/catharsis)！ - [FurSky Reborn](https://modrinth.com/resourcepack/furfsky-reborn) - 需要 [Catharsis](https://modrinth.com/mod/catharsis)！ - [Skyblock Dark UI](https://modrinth.com/resourcepack/skyblock-dark-ui)
